calib_probs: calib_probs.jsonl (per-option probabilities of every slice decision, untempered)
rule: scalar T = the NLL minimiser over all calib questions (bounded), moved toward 1 if it would raise the slice's yes/no 0.2-0.8 band rate above T = 1's; fitted before any eval answer is tempered

noul.flag: no T in [lo, hi] meets the band threshold: T with the lowest band rate

per_type.rule: T_noul is chosen to minimise slice NLL subject to slice yes/no band rate <= stock's + 0.05 (stock = the in-job stock + shim readout on the same slice); choice / score T = the slice-NLL minimiser (+ (type, K) cells with >= min_cell decisions)
